what: On the hero, the big copy over the photo stays pinned to the screen. As the photo slides up, only the part of each line past the photo’s bottom edge changes from light text (over the photo) to dark text (over the white background). Two copies of the same copy are stacked and split with clip-path at the edge height. When the top edge of the next section title (until) reaches 40px below the copy, the pin releases and the copy settles onto it and flows along together

options.[data-fx-part=light]: Copy shown over the photo (light text)
options.[data-fx-part=dark]: One more set of the same copy (dark text) — layered on top. Only the dark line may be painted as gradient text.
options.edge: Boundary element CSS (photo panel) — it splits at the bottom edge of this element. Default is the parent
options.until: CSS of the reference element that releases the pin (next section title) — if none, only the split happens without pinning
options.gap: Gap between the copy and the top edge of until (px), default 40
options.--fx-light · --fx-dark: Two text colors, default var(--kf-on-accent) · var(--kf-ink)
